implementation.placement: After existing mixed output clamping and before the existing callback-epoch release increment. No mixer, stream position, format or AudioUnit route changes.
implementation.skipParsing: Strict unsigned decimal; invalid, overflow or out-of-range rejects capture setup.
implementation.deadline: Monotonic endpoint-creation time plus floor(skip_frames / 48000) + 45 seconds. Deadline closes only an unowned producer admission word.
implementation.realTimePath: Only bounded copies, scalar metadata and nonblocking lock-free atomics using preallocated, pre-touched arrays. No allocation, clock query, file I/O, logging or blocking lock/wait in the capture callback path.
implementation.producerOwnership: Packed unsigned CLOSED admission bit plus participant count. Only the sole producer writes arrays; contending callbacks return without copying. Closing while another admitted participant remains marks producer_contention. Worker acquires DONE before export/free.
implementation.workerOutput: One private Documents/anyps5-audio-captures/postmix-<pid>-<monotonicns>.wav plus matching .json with callback timestamps/epoch, requested/effective/skipped/captured frame counts and host timebase.
implementation.fileSafety: Worker-only O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW files mode0600; reserves both names before writing; rolls back only newly owned files on failure, preserving existing files.

focusedNativeQualification.scope: Production capture/export/worker code and extracted actual before/after mixer/render callback text, using explicit Core Audio declaration mocks and original synthetic samples.
focusedNativeQualification.testedOutputByteCapacities: 0 through140 inclusive, including truncated/non-frame-aligned buffers; post-sum clamp independent oracle; ring positions/clamp count/callback epoch unchanged.
tests: All six gate values; inactive setup has no capture allocations or worker.
Skip across callbacks, prefix capture cap, record overflow, unsupported format/null source, zero/cancelled admission and untouched guards/tail.
Deterministic delayed-contender and CLOSED-with-active-participant controls; no concurrent stress or ThreadSanitizer qualification.
Worker full 480000-frame export with 469 callback records and final 768-frame partial callback.
Float WAV framing and timestamp metadata; nonfinite sample_time becomes null.
Short writes and EINTR succeed; partial ENOSPC, zero-write, EIO and invalid-directory exports fail with newly created file cleanup.
Existing WAV/metadata collision is not overwritten or deleted; allocation failure rolls back buffers and closes the directory.
focusedNativeQualification.syntaxWarning: One inherited AUDCLNT_E_NOT_INITIALIZED macro redefinition; no new compile error.

limits: 480000 frames represents 10 seconds of rendered 48k audio; callback timestamp/epoch metadata is needed to establish wall-clock continuity.
Capture format is observed and requires existing 48k stereo output; no resampling or hidden format changes.
A permanently stalled active producer can delay export indefinitely. Buffers remain bounded and are never exported/freed while actively owned.
The synthetic fixture mocks Core Audio declarations. Full actual iOS TU compile and app link/sign are additional proof, but no AudioUnit/device capture or audible-quality proof.
Source/function parity does not qualify the opt-in callback copy cost on hardware.
Codesign and cached-profile checks do not prove device installation, JIT activation, runtime or sound quality.
No private captured audio, game assets, raw diagnostics, provisioning identities or absolute private paths are included in this record.
